scene.title: SCENE III. York. The Archbishop's palace.

content.text: Enter the Archbishop, the Lords Hastings, Mowbray and Bardolph.

lines.text: Thus have you heard our cause and known our means,
lines.plainText: Thus have you heard our cause and known our means

lines.text: And, my most noble friends, I pray you all
lines.plainText: And my most noble friends I pray you all

lines.plainText: And first Lord Marshal what say you to it

lines.plainText: But gladly would be better satisfied

lines.plainText: How in our means we should advance ourselves

lines.plainText: To look with forehead bold and big enough

lines.plainText: Till we had his assistance by the hand

lines.plainText: It was young Hotspur's case at Shrewsbury

lines.text: It was, my lord; who lined himself with hope,
lines.plainText: It was my lord who lined himself with hope

lines.plainText: Eating the air on promise of supply

lines.plainText: Proper to madmen led his powers to death

lines.plainText: And winking leap'd into destruction

lines.plainText: But by your leave it never yet did hurt

lines.plainText: To lay down likelihoods and forms of hope

lines.plainText: Lives so in hope as in an early spring

lines.plainText: Hope gives not so much warrant as despair

lines.plainText: Which is almost to pluck a kingdom down

lines.plainText: To weigh against his opposite or else

lines.plainText: Like one that draws the model of a house

lines.plainText: Gives o'er and leaves his partcreated cost
